result.verdict: PASS — all 8 acceptance criteria covered; no implementation code; no TBD/deferrals; count? rationale clear; ISS-0822 decision and S5 scope recording unambiguous.
result.next_action: Route to ELIXIR-DEV (Step 2a) and/or FRONTEND-DEV (Step 2b). This is a retroactive WF-03 run — implementations are already committed; downstream steps verify the committed code against the design.

AC1_fixtures_no_has_more.evidence: §2.1 enumerates all four fixture sites with file paths and line numbers. Each is documented to match the real route shape ({items, next_cursor} for hand-built routes; {items, next_cursor, count} for Pagination.page_response/2 routes).

AC2_pagination_via_next_cursor.evidence: §2.2 explicitly documents next_cursor !== null as the retained discriminating check in all four tests. TC-ISS0821-04 pins this as the canonical 'no more pages' signal.

AC3_prevention_mechanism.evidence: §2.3 specifies cursor-page-wire-shape.test.ts: compile-time guard via TypeScript structural typing on CursorPage<T> (re-introducing has_more: boolean as required would fail tsc); runtime guard TC-ISS0821-03 uses Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call to assert has_more is absent as an own property — catches has_more: false as well as has_more: true.

AC4_lands_with_or_after_type_fix.evidence: §4 AC table documents commit a34305f7 (type fix, ISS-0816) as preceding/accompanying d8fa8096 (fixtures, ISS-0821).

AC1_route_removed_or_gated.evidence: §3.1 selects Option A (remove outright). Rationale: a 404-on-every-request route is indistinguishable from a broken deployment; removal is the minimum change that eliminates the confusion. Silent-404 is explicitly declared unacceptable.

AC2_decision_recorded_against_S5.evidence: §3.4 is a standalone decision record stating deferral to S5, naming the retained frontend stubs and their rationale, and documenting that the decision is recorded in router.ex's moduledoc.

AC3_modules_ts_audited.evidence: Surface is removed, not kept. §3.1/§3.4 document that api/modules.ts and hooks/useModules.ts have no live callers and no mounted route exists for their URL prefixes — audit result is stated definitively.

AC4_no_other_spa_route_points_at_deferre.evidence: §3.3 provides a table of all remaining deferred routers and their SPA route status. States explicitly: 'No other SPA route in web/src/router.tsx points at a router in the deferred table — this was verified by cross-referencing every path: entry in router.tsx against the current api_pipeline.ex forward table.'

no_implementation_code.notes: No .ex/.exs function bodies present. @derive annotation and defstruct are quoted as source evidence, not implementations. TypeScript block is an interface declaration (type shape only). No function bodies anywhere in the document.

count_optional_rationale_clear.notes: §1.2–1.3 are unambiguous: Pagination.page_response/2 routes always emit count; three named hand-built route families (definitions/search, dlq, promotions) do not. Optionality fully justified with named files and route contexts. Sufficient to implement from.

admin_modules_decision_unambiguous.notes: §3.1 names all three options considered, selects A with clear rationale. §3.4 is a self-contained decision record. No TBD or deferred language.

no_tbd_or_deferrals.notes: §5 Open Questions: None. All design decisions stated definitively including the audit.ex has_more internal usage (lines :276, :295-297) confirmed as not emitted on the wire.
